vulnerabilities.description: Improper authentication validation allows admin actions (create, delete cars) with any fake token — auth middleware accepts all Bearer tokens without validation
SQL injection in search API — user-supplied query parameter is concatenated directly into raw SQL without parameterization, allowing an attacker to retrieve all records
Stored XSS via unsanitized car description rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML on the Specs tab — attacker-controlled HTML/script executes in victim's browser
